caption: The video captures a woman dancing in a bright studio with white walls, a dark ceiling of track lights, and a full-height mirror on the right reflecting her front. Seen from behind, she wears a gray tank top, a yellow wrap skirt, yellow leg warmers and white sneakers, dark hair in a ponytail and side braid. In the opening frames her arms are raised with open hands near head height, mirrored as if clapping. She brings her hands together in front of her chest, then lets them drop while lifting one foot behind her with a bent knee. The kick-behind is held with a rhythmic bounce, the skirt hem swaying, as her arms swing at her sides. After planting both feet, she places one hand on her hip and raises the bent foot again. She then lowers it and lifts it once more as her arms swing free from her hip, the foot lowering toward the floor in the final frames.
relations: Raised arms move together at the chest, then drop to the sides as one foot lifts behind.
The lifted foot with bent knee bounces rhythmically, causing the yellow skirt hem to sway.
After planting feet, one hand rests on the hip while the other foot lifts and lowers again.
The full-height mirror reflects her front view, mirroring the arm and leg movements in real time.
